payload.name: Extract All Explicit Facts from a Message
payload.description: When a single message explicitly states multiple distinct durable facts (e.g., an event plus a peripheral detail), during extraction.
content: During extraction, when a message contains multiple distinct explicit facts (e.g., a speaker states they signed up for a class and also describes an incidental encounter), create a separate candidate for each distinct fact; do not let one salient detail suppress the other.
Identify the primary stated action, plan, or event and ensure it is captured, even if the message also contains a concrete or colorful peripheral detail.
Stop after all explicitly stated durable facts have been captured; do not add unstated inferences or duplicate candidates for the same fact.

solves: During extraction, when a user message explicitly states multiple distinct durable facts, the extractor may capture only the most salient or concrete detail and omit the primary action or plan, leading to missing memories. This skill ensures all explicitly stated facts, especially the primary event or plan, are captured in separate candidates without inventing unstated details.
